messages:
marie: Quick chase on overdue PM actions from RED-2203. The tracking sheet shows two items past due and one without an owner. Can folks confirm status today so I can close the loop?

jon: I picked up RED-7824 (adjust DB connection backoff) last week. Had a WIP but got pulled into a live incident. I should have a small fix and PR by EOD.

tia: I'm listed as owner for RED-7830 (monitoring + synthetic). I created a draft synthetic but blocked on a metric permission. Filed INC-5780 for the permission grant.

infra-bot: Reminder: RED-7824 due 2026-04-12 (assigned to jon). RED-7830 due 2026-04-11 (assigned to tia).

marie: If either of you cannot finish today, please set your ticket to "Needs Reassign" and ping me so we can reallocate. This PM is flagged as a repeat pattern - want to avoid staleness.

jon: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/pull/9138. Changes are minimal backoff + better error classification. Need someone from SRE to review and confirm no alert storms.

tia: INC-5780 approved by cloud team. Thanks folks. I'll finish wiring the synthetic and push a PR within 2 hours.

ops: FYI permission INC-5780 applied (change id 2026-04-04T14:20Z).

jon: Added test coverage and addressed review comments. Merged: commit e5a4b11. Updated RED-7824 with commit and deployment notes (deploy 12:00 UTC). Set status to "Ready for Verify".

tia: Synthetic PR merged: commit c9b8d2f. Synthetic scheduled at 5m intervals, alert at 80% pool utilization. Updated RED-7830 with commit and runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/db-pool#synthetic. Marked resolved.

marie: Great progress. Two final asks for closure: 1) paste the exact deployment windows into tickets if not already there; 2) infra, please add the permission change to the infra change log so capacity reviews can see the long-term setting.

ops: Permission change logged in INC-5780 change log with timestamp.

marie: OK I'm going to mark the PM follow-up cluster as CLOSED in the tracker and note the recurrence mitigation (synthetic + monthly capacity review). If anything reopens, please ping me. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Action: Postmortem follow-ups for RED-2203 marked CLOSED by marie.

jon: Thanks all. Learned to request permission earlier in the flow.

tia: Closing my side. Will keep an eye on the synthetic for the next week.

marie: Thread closed.
